tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__vercel_create_sandboxes_v4
tools.description:
Creates a named sandbox environment. Named sandboxes have a unique name within a project and support automatic snapshotting on shutdown. When no `image` is provided (and the sandbox is not restored from a snapshot), the sandbox is created from the default universal image. Unlike v3, snapshots expire after 7 days by default and persistent sandboxes keep only their most recent snapshot unless `keepLastSnapshots` is configured otherwise (or set to `null` to disable the limit).

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel --scope {teamSlugOrId} sandbox create --project {projectIdOrName}. Fill placeholders from inputs.

Provides access to documentation search for a specific hosting and deployment platform and tools to manage its projects and deployments, including listing projects, deployments, build logs, and creating temporary authenticated share URLs or fetching protected deployment URLs. Also supports deploying the current project through the platform’s API, listing teams, and checking domain availability and pricing.

MCP server instructions: Vercel MCP provides over 200 tools. Capabilities:
Deployments: builds, status/logs/files, aliases, promotions, rollbacks, rolling releases and sharing/access.
Insights: runtime errors/logs, Web Analytics, observability metrics, usage/billing and agent run traces.
Configuration: projects, accounts/teams/access groups, environment variables, domains/pricing/registration, DNS/TLS, routes/redirects, microfrontends, feature flags, Blob stores and Global Config (Edge Config).
